summary: Iteration 4 — Zoho live-ready integration tested up to the OAuth boundary (no real Zoho credentials). Backend: 17/17 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4_zoho.py pass covering (a) PUT /zoho/settings mode=live — response masks secret as client_secret_masked (first 4 chars + 8 bullets), returns selected_mode='live' with effective mode='mock' and connected=false (no refresh token), and the stored client_secret in mongo zoho_settings is a Fernet 'gAAAAA…' token (NOT plaintext); non-admin GET/PUT -> 403, (b) POST /zoho/connect in live mode -> auth_url at accounts.zoho.com.au/oauth/v2/auth with scope including ZohoInventory.inventoryadjustments.CREATE, response_type=code, access_type=offline, prompt=consent and a state param; missing fields -> 400 'Save these first: client_id, client_secret, organization_id, redirect_uri'; data_center=com -> accounts.zoho.com; non-admin -> 403, (c) GET /zoho/callback — wrong state and missing state both -> HTML 400 'Connection failed'; error=access_denied -> HTML 400 'Zoho connection cancelled' including the error token, (d) GET /zoho/locations and POST /zoho/import without refresh token -> 400 'Switch to Live mode and connect Zoho first'; non-admin -> 403, (e) Mock regression — switching mode=mock then POST /zoho/connect returns {mode:'mock', connected:true, auth_url:null}; driller take request + QLD mgr approve still produces status='approved', zoho_mode='mock' and zoho_txn_id starting with 'MOCK-ADJ-', (f) Final cleanup — settings restored to mode=mock with client_id/organization_id cleared (verified via GET). Frontend: admin login → Settings tab (More) → Zoho integration loads [data-testid=zoho-screen]; setup-help card [zoho-setup-help] visible with Open Zoho API Console button [zoho-open-console]; mode chips present [zoho-mode-mock], [zoho-mode-live]; redirect URI field prefilled with https://drill-stockroom.preview.emergentagent.com/api/zoho/callback; adjustment account field visible [zoho-adj-account-input]; filled live credentials (1000.UITEST / ui-test-secret / 60000001) and tapped Save -> toast 'Zoho settings saved'. However the 'Load Zoho locations' button and 'Import items & stock' card did NOT appear after saving in live mode (see frontend_issues). Final cleanup done via UI: switched back to Mock, cleared client_id/org, Save → confirmed via GET /zoho/settings that selected_mode=mock, mode=mock, client_id='', organization_id=''. No red screen, no deprecated expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch references found. Minor console warnings (useNativeDriver not supported on web; props.pointerEvents deprecated) are RN-web environment noise, not functional issues.

ui_bugs.issue: After saving mode=live with credentials, the 'Load Zoho locations' button [zoho-load-locations] and the 'Import items & stock' card [zoho-import-card] stay hidden until a successful OAuth connect lands a refresh token. Both are gated on q.data?.mode === 'live' (the EFFECTIVE mode from GET /zoho/settings) which only flips to 'live' once has_refresh_token is true. The review spec requires them to be visible as soon as the user saves live-mode so they can tap Load (expected to error until connected). Fix: gate on q.data?.selected_mode === 'live' (or on f.mode === 'live') instead. Reference: /app/frontend/app/zoho.tsx:134 and :152.

action_items: In /app/frontend/app/zoho.tsx, change the two visibility guards from `q.data?.mode === 'live'` to `q.data?.selected_mode === 'live'` (or `f?.mode === 'live'`) at lines 134 and 152, so Load-locations and Import card appear once the admin has SAVED in live mode (even before OAuth completes). Users will still get a toast error from the backend ('Switch to Live mode and connect Zoho first') if they tap before connecting — which matches the spec's 'buttons will error with toast since not connected — that's expected'.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py now 1430+ lines (grew another ~200 for /zoho/* endpoints, settings, locations, import, callback HTML). Monolithic but still readable; splitting into routers (auth, zoho, kits, receipts, products) remains a non-blocking tech-debt item.

zoho_api.py exchange_code honours an unvalidated `accounts_server` query-string from the Zoho callback but server.py correctly whitelists it against DCS before passing (zoho_callback line 1211-1213). Good.
Fernet-based encryption for client_secret and refresh_token with legacy-plaintext fallback (dec() InvalidToken catch) is sensible for backwards compatibility.
zoho_api.call() uses time.sleep inside run_in_threadpool-called functions — correct (backoff is in a worker thread, not the event loop).
server.py get_zoho exposes `has_refresh_token` boolean and masked secret — never leaks plaintext secret or refresh token. Good.

PUT /zoho/settings preserves an existing encrypted client_secret when the body omits it (only overwrites when non-blank). This is a UX feature (so saving does not require re-entering the secret) but means POST /zoho/connect's missing-fields check may NOT list 'client_secret' if a prior secret is still stored. Tests account for this by zeroing it via mongo before asserting the full missing list.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — all setup/mode/field/save flows green; 1 visibility gating bug for Load-locations + Import card after live save

rca_of_issue: zoho.tsx line 134 and 152 gate 'Load Zoho locations' and the 'Import items & stock' card on `q.data?.mode === 'live'`. The backend GET /zoho/settings returns `mode: 'live' if zoho.is_live(s) else 'mock'` and `is_live(s)` requires BOTH mode=='live' AND a refresh_token. So the effective `mode` field only flips to 'live' once OAuth has completed. The admin UI therefore cannot show the Load-locations/Import affordances after saving credentials but before connecting — breaking the saved-live user-journey the review request calls out. Fix: swap to `q.data?.selected_mode === 'live'` (which reflects user's chosen mode independent of refresh token).
